cards.label: Greenwich Market
cards.text: By the market, a busker inflates himself explaining the finer points of the zero meridian to a strictly disinterested crowd. He clocks you before you clock him.

cards.speaker: Busker
cards.text: "You look like someone who deals in the good stuff. I know things - like where some small timers may have stashed some calc. Worth twenty quid to a man who knows how to spend it."
He's either got something, or he's very good at pretending.

choices.label: Give him £20
choices.result_text: He pockets the note and taps the side of his nose. "Bus stop outside the McDonalds. Paving stone next to the bench is loose; lift it up and you'll get a nice surprise". Funnily, he's telling the truth; there's a small stash of calc. Or more accurately, there WAS a small stash of calc.

choices.label: Keep walking
choices.result_text: You keep walking. He shouts something about the Meridian after you. You don't catch it, and don't ask him to repeat it.

cards.text: Whether or not he was lying, Greenwich feels marginally more interesting than it did five minutes ago.
